AI Assist Now Available

Your Answer is Already in the Board Book

Ask the sharp question in every meeting, with answers drawn from your board's full context: board books, Resources, published minutes, and years of meeting history, searched together. Semantic search reads for meaning, so AI Assist finds the discussion you have in mind even when the minutes used different words.

LEARN MORE
WATCH IT WORK

Cut the Admin Chaos and Publish the Agenda Sooner

Swap last-minute panic for a repeatable meeting process. Start with a prompt to set the agenda, link sections to live sources, and propagate the right pages with a single change. Transcribe with AI to capture discussion, motions, and votes in real time, and review drafted minutes as soon as the meeting ends.

Give Directors an Easy-to-Adopt Experience

Deliver a professional board management experience that sets members up for success: one place to prepare, annotate, vote, and sign. The book stays current and keeps insights front and center, so directors walk in ready to decide.

TRY NOW

Build a Single, Searchable Governance Library

Place policies and past packets in one secure hub so members find answers without asking. Keep drafts and downloads out of email and control access by role, replace documents in place, and keep clean records for audits.

Protect Sensitive Data Without Adding Friction

Keep sensitive board work inside one governed space with no inbox copies and no stray downloads. Align access with role permissions, log every action, and set automatic retention by default. Contain data inside your system while giving the board access to insights with AI built for boards.
